title: The closed-form radial map Φ takes values in [0,1]^P and in the (m+1)-skeleton
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, a ∈ Euclid P with |a_i − 1/2| < 1/4 for all i, κ : (Fin P → ℝ) → ℝ such that for every u there is a finset s with P ≤ m + 1 + |s| and κ(u) ≤ u_i for all i ∈ s, and suppose Φ : Euclid P → Euclid P satisfies Φ(y)_i = a_i + (y_i − a_i)/max(r_i(y), κ(r(y))) for all y and i (real division with the convention x/0 = 0, as in Lean; the denominator vanishes only when r_i(y) = 0 and κ(r(y)) ≤ 0), where r(y) denotes the function j ↦ r_j(y) := max((y_j − a_j)/(1 − a_j), (a_j − y_j)/a_j) (= (y_j − a_j)/(1 − a_j) if y_j ≥ a_j, and = (a_j − y_j)/a_j if y_j < a_j). If y ∈ Euclid P satisfies κ(r(y)) > 0, then 0 ≤ Φ(y)_i ≤ 1 for every i, and there is a finset s with P ≤ m + 1 + |s| and Φ(y)_i ∈ {0, 1} for every i ∈ s.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a : Euclid P), (∀ i, |a i - 1 / 2| < 1 / 4) → ∀ κ : (Fin P → ℝ) → ℝ, (∀ u : Fin P → ℝ, ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), P ≤ m + 1 + s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, κ u ≤ u i) → ∀ Φ : Euclid P → Euclid P, (∀ (y : Euclid P) (i : Fin P), Φ y i = a i + (y i - a i) / max (max ((y i - a i) / (1 - a i)) ((a i - y i) / a i)) (κ (fun j => max ((y j - a j) / (1 - a j)) ((a j - y j) / a j)))) → ∀ y : Euclid P, 0 < κ (fun j => max ((y j - a j) / (1 - a j)) ((a j - y j) / a j)) → (∀ i, 0 ≤ Φ y i ∧ Φ y i ≤ 1) ∧ ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), P ≤ m + 1 + s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, Φ y i = 0 ∨ Φ y i = 1
